message.content:
Sure! If you’re looking for a convenient way to bake a chocolate cake without having to use a full-size oven, here are some great options:

| Machine | Why it’s good for cakes | Key Features |
|---------|------------------------|--------------|
| **Countertop Convection Oven** (e.g., Breville Smart Oven Air) | Provides even heat distribution and precise temperature control, so your cake bakes evenly and stays moist. | 3‑zone heating, convection fan, adjustable rack height, digital display & timer |
| **Smart Oven** (e.g., June Oven, Tovala) | Uses sensors to detect doneness and automatically adjusts time/temperature. Great if you want minimal hands‑on time. | Wi‑Fi connectivity, app control, auto‑detect settings, built‑in camera |
| **Toaster Oven** (e.g., Cuisinart TOA-60) | Compact but powerful enough for a single layer cake; many models have a “cake” preset. | 5‑level temperature dial, removable crumb tray, quick‑heat feature |
| **Bread/Cake Maker** (e.g., Zojirushi Breadmaker with Cake Setting) | Some bread makers come with a cake setting that mixes batter and bakes at the right temperature. | Automatic mixing, built‑in timer, easy cleanup |
| **Microwave with Baking Function** (e.g., Panasonic NN-SN966S) | For a quick “microwave cake” – not a traditional baked cake, but perfect for a single serving. | Microwave + convection mode, adjustable power levels, easy cleanup |
| **Instant Pot Duo Plus** (with “Cake” setting) | Uses pressure cooking to keep moisture inside, producing a tender crumb. | Pressure cook, steam, sauté modes, programmable timer |
| **Slow Cooker** (e.g., Crock‑Pot) | Slow‑cooking keeps the cake moist; works best for a dense, fudgy texture. | Adjustable temperature, lock‑in lid, easy cleanup |

### How to choose:
1. **Size & Capacity** – If you plan to bake multiple layers or larger cakes, look for a larger oven or one with adjustable racks.
2. **Temperature Accuracy** – A convection oven or smart oven will give you more consistent results than a basic toaster oven.
3. **Ease of Use** – Smart ovens let you set everything via an app, while a simple toaster oven requires manual adjustments.
4. **Cleaning** – Removable trays and non‑stick interiors make cleanup easier.

Once you pick a machine, you’ll just need a reliable chocolate cake recipe—most of the above appliances come with preset “cake” programs that handle the timing and temperature for you. Happy baking!
